item.name: Returns density data inside the specified box for the given entry. For X-ray data, returns 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes in a single response.

request.name: Returns density data inside the specified box for the given entry. For X-ray data, returns 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes in a single response.

query.description: Determines if text based CIF or binary BinaryCIF encoding is used. An optional argument, default is BinaryCIF encoding.

Determines the maximum number of voxels the query can return. Possible values are in the range from 0 (0.52M voxels) to 6 (25.17M voxels). Default value is 0. Note: different detail levels might lead to the same result.
Determines the coordinate space the query is in. Can be cartesian or fractional. An optional argument, default values is cartesian.

variable.description: (Required) Specifies the data source (determined by the experiment method). Currently supported sources are: x-ray, em.
(Required) Id of the entry. For x-ray, use PDB ID (i.e. 1cbs) and for em use EMDB id (i.e. emd-8116).
(Required) Bottom left corner of the query region in Cartesian or fractional coordinates (determined by the `space` query parameter).
(Required) Top right corner of the query region in Cartesian or fractional coordinates (determined by the `space` query parameter).
